promotionNote: Promoted advisory -> blocking 2026-08-11 (ai-slop debt burn-down, tasks/archive/2026-08-10-ai-slop-debt-burndown.md) after production sites reached zero for all three rules. All three are 'error' in eslint.config.mjs for production source and 'off' for test files (idiomatic test-double typing).

rules.name: sam/no-unvalidated-request-json
rules.evidenceIncident: Typed Hono request JSON masks unvalidated request bodies at runtime.
falsePositiveSamples: Untyped c.req.json() calls are intentionally excluded for this syntax rule.
Route handlers already using jsonValidator(schema) are handled by integration wiring, not this isolated syntax matcher.

rules.name: sam/no-unsafe-json-parse-assertion
rules.evidenceIncident: Type assertions over JSON.parse were repeatedly mistaken for runtime validation.
falsePositiveSamples: JSON.parse(raw) as unknown is allowed as the neutral parse boundary.
Non-JSON.parse assertions are excluded even when their target type is structural.

rules.name: sam/no-local-record-guard
rules.evidenceIncident: Local record/object guards drift from established runtime-validation helpers.
falsePositiveSamples: Guards with different names are excluded.
Guards with extra semantic checks are excluded because automatic replacement is unsafe.

rules.name: sam/no-unguarded-outbound-fetch
rules.evidenceIncident: Landing-plan finding F6: the integration branch inventoried outbound fetch sites with a regex/AST test that (0,fetch), Reflect.apply and SDK baseURLs evaded, and that did not cover cloudflare:sockets or packages/*.
falsePositiveSamples: Requests to URLs the code fixes (Cloudflare API, provider APIs, SAM-derived hosts) are acknowledged inline with an eslint-disable-next-line comment naming who chooses the URL.
Binding and Durable Object stub .fetch() calls are not the global fetch and are not matched.
knownGaps: Calls through an existing wrapper (fetchWithTimeout, providerFetch) are counted once, at the wrapper's own global-fetch site, not at each caller.
An SDK constructed with a user-chosen baseURL sends requests the rule cannot see.
